message.content:
A magazine cover features a grayscale illustration of a man with spectacles and a white shirt against a red background. The man's face, rendered in shades of gray, shows an open-mouthed expression with his head tilted. He holds a book titled "1998" in his left hand, while his right hand holds a torn, jagged piece of paper above his head. Smaller white paper fragments fly through the air.

The top of the cover displays the word "TEMPO" in large, black capital letters. Above this, white text reads "Dampak Ekonomi Perang Iran-Israel H.100" and "Akal-akalan Berbagi Risiko Asuransi H.90". Below the title, the slogan "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" is partially visible. 

To the right, large black text states "UTAK-ATIK SEJARAH RESMI". Below this, a block of smaller black text details a claim about historical events and mentions a page number, "H.24". At the bottom, the dates "23-29 JUNI 2025," the price "RP 60.000," a website, and a barcode with a QR code are visible.
